items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The person that really influenced me was Mr. Weist. Because he took an interest in me

ctx.x: Any other memorable moments as far as your early music career at this point? About junior high school years, any bands that you saw or any other people that had an influence on you musically at this point?

The person that really influenced me was Mr. Weist. Because he took an interest in me he said, “you know look if you practice this, and if you do it till your muscles ache just keep practicing till your muscles stop aching and you’ll know how to do it! Just don’t think about it—hypnotize yourself.”
He sounds like a Zen master! (Laughs)
